feature: Rust primitive integer conversions and expression context

breadth.scope: Complete changed records classified by syntax-tree and modular-integer transformations, alongside whole-body native probes and source guard review. This does not establish native equivalence for whole runtime images.
limitations: Native Rust checks use overflow-checks=off to model wrapping machine arithmetic.
Primitive casts and exact core identity calls are stripped for structural comparison; rendered-type correctness also relies on same-width source guards and targeted native probes.
Associative integer operations may regroup without reordering operands; local name/field compound assignments expand without evaluating a pointer expression twice.

For the 94 records with a raw parse error in either arm, the review also erases primitive casts lexically and renames invalid fn/self/underscore-path identifiers before parsing; raw output and parser status remain retained. This is review-only normalization, not a native body rewrite.
STORE-width and direct-STORE signedness repairs are outside this feature.
